drug_class: Diabetes Management Device / Insulin Delivery Accessory
purpose: This is a small, short needle that attaches to your insulin pen to help you inject insulin under your skin. It is designed with a dual safety shield that covers the needle before and after use to protect you from accidental needle sticks. It makes giving yourself insulin injections safer, easier, and more comfortable.
how_it_works: The pen needle screws onto the tip of your insulin pen. When you press the pen to your skin, the safety shield retracts and the tiny needle delivers insulin just under the surface of your skin. After the injection, the shield automatically covers the needle again so you cannot accidentally poke yourself when removing or disposing of it.
common_side_effects: Mild pain, redness, or bruising at the injection site. Skin irritation or small bumps if you inject in the same spot too often. These effects are usually minor and go away quickly.
warnings: Always use a brand new needle for each injection — never reuse needles, as this can cause pain, infection, or inaccurate dosing. Do not share needles with anyone else. Dispose of used needles in an approved sharps container. Rotate your injection sites to avoid hard lumps under the skin called lipohypertrophy. Check with your doctor or pharmacist to make sure you are using the correct needle length for your body type.
typical_dosing: Use one new pen needle each time you give an insulin injection as directed by your doctor. Needles come in different lengths (usually 4mm to 8mm) — your healthcare provider will recommend the right size for you. Always follow your insulin dosing schedule and injection technique as shown by your diabetes care team.
